      Problem: The new logic for "Preserving newly created files in workflow source repo" lacks an exclusion for node_modules.; When IS_WORKFLOW_SOURCE_REPO=true, the workflow logs all untracked files via git ls-files --others --exclude-standard. If an editor action or a step like npm install (run by a developer or automated tool) creates a nested node_modules directory that isn't yet in .gitignore, thousands of files will be logged to stdout. More importantly, these files will then be processed by the SHA-based snapshotting logic in lines 1740-1803, which calls git hash-object on every file. This can lead to significant performance degradation or "Argument list too long" errors when attempting to generate the touched-file list, as seen in previous similar regressions.
